dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Welcome to the Ratnik garrison city of Piramida. This public board has been installed to facilitate communication in the city. Any information related to Piramida and the Ratniki may be posted here."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "We do not guarantee the veracity of content posted by individuals on this board, and all information must be verified independently. Please report any fraudulent posts immediately to former Sergeant Major Lyubertsi."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "This notice is posted to serve as both a warning and a record of a prior incident in which a new Ratnik recruit was deceived by a woman from Sumeru posing as a ritual officiant of the Frostmoon Scions. This deception resulted in the leakage of supply intelligence."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Reminder: Do not enter dangerous areas unless you are on official duty."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Effective immediately, the Snowfield Falcons investigation squad will replace the Wildnight Owls in conducting patrol duties around Piramida."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Inga Birkendal, Squad Leader of the Wildnight Owls, is hereby temporarily suspended from all duties. Any further measures taken will be announced as appropriate."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Individuals interested in becoming a Ratnik are advised to consult former Sergeant Major Lyubertsi regarding selection-related matters."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Be advised: The title of Ratnik is neither about glory nor prestige, nor a source of fame or fortune. We are Lightkeepers, and our sole possession is the biting north wind that blows over the wasteland."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "But should you still choose to be the flame of hope for the living, you are welcome to join our cause. May our lamps never fade, and may the light of early morn ever endure."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Due to recent signs of large-scale encroachment by the Wild Hunt around Dreadshade Mire, all Ratniki are advised to exercise heightened caution while discharging their duties."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Avoid entering high-risk areas unless specifically required. Remain alert at all times, for safety is our highest priority."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Alyosha Dmitriyevich, member of the Snowfield Falcons investigation squad, was found to be intoxicated while on sentry duty. While no personnel or supply losses occurred as a result, this nevertheless constitutes a case of serious misconduct."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Dmitriyevich is hereby suspended from all Lightkeeper duties with immediate effect. He shall also be reassigned to assist Squad Leader Inga Birkendal with logistical tasks."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "All squads are urged to regard this incident as a warning, and refrain from excessive drinking."

dialogues.speaker: Notice From a Traveling Merchant
dialogues.text: "Destiny is woven like a tapestry; I myself have determined it. With the night wind and the currents as my guides, I have finally set foot upon this snowy plain."

dialogues.speaker: Notice From a Traveling Merchant
dialogues.text: "I am Kofitse, a supplicant from Mict{RUBY#[D]Masters of the Night-Wind}lan. I have come to this land to guide the warriors of Nephil{RUBY#[D]Nod-Krai}heim."

dialogues.speaker: Notice From a Traveling Merchant
dialogues.text: "Just as the light of the Nephil{RUBY#[D]Nod-Krai}heim warriors dispels the dark night, the hornshrooms I have brought with me this time possess an equal efficacy."

dialogues.speaker: Notice From a Traveling Merchant
dialogues.text: "This miracle that has been passed down in Mict{RUBY#[D]Masters of the Night-Wind}lan for a thousand years is also a glimmer of hope that shines within the darkness."

dialogues.speaker: Notice From a Traveling Merchant
dialogues.text: "If you wish to receive the Wayob's guidance, you are welcome to follow the night wind and join us."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "The recent surge in Wild Hunt incidents has led to an increasing number of wounded among our ranks. This has, in turn, caused a serious shortage of medical supplies such as bandages."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Sergeant Major Gabieta has contacted the Voynich Guild for assistance, and we hope to receive a supply shipment soon."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "In the interim, our medical staff urge all Ratniki to prioritize their personal safety and exercise utmost caution while discharging their duties."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "The Wild Hunt scourge has recently impacted patrol routes near Afterglow Cavern to the south. All personnel are reminded to remain vigilant while on duty."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "Please take note that the merchants formerly utilizing this route have altered their travel arrangements. Therefore, we do not expect supply deliveries to be significantly affected."

dialogues.speaker: Ratnik Mess Hall Notice
dialogues.text: "Dear Everyone: We have new dishes available in the mess hall! Thanks to some truly generous friends, our new recipes are now ready to be served. Enjoy!"

dialogues.speaker: Ratnik Mess Hall Notice
dialogues.text: "And this time, we have mushroom-flavored bread! It's sweet, it's got a nice crispy crust, so be sure to come and have a taste!"

dialogues.speaker: Message From a Ratnik
dialogues.text: "For sale: A greatsword, but at a low price. Well-maintained and virtually new, guaranteed to last for ten years or more. Contact Inga for more details."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Don't believe what she says. There's no way that sword can be used for another decade. In fact, it looks more like something my Uncle Sigurd might have used and thrown out a decade ago."

dialogues.speaker: Message From a Ratnik
dialogues.text: "Malusha — what did I ever do to you? Why are you doing this?"

dialogues.speaker: Notice From Hertta's Workshop
dialogues.text: "We've just received a new batch of high-quality metal materials, courtesy of the Voynich Guild! If you are looking to commission a new weapon, now is the perfect time. Please remember to make an appointment before your visit."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Me! Me! Me! I need a sword! I just chipped my old one, and was just thinking about getting a new one."

dialogues.speaker: Notice From Hertta's Workshop
dialogues.text: "We didn't mean make an appointment HERE on the notice board!"

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "We are pleased to announce that thanks to the tireless efforts of the Nightmare Orioles, the monster that was sealed by the Torchforger at Kipumaki Cliff has been completely defeated."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "They braved every danger, pressed on through the storm, and carved a path to victory from the depths of despair."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "However, even as we mark this victory, let us not forget those who are no longer with us: They have fulfilled the vow we all once made with their blood."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki Notice
dialogues.text: "We shall part the snow-curtain of the sky, and blast the winter winds across the wasteland. The winds awaken, and the leaves whirl round."
